hypothesis.statement: On a real drifting frontopolar EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, Fpz), detrendSignal reproduces scipy.signal.detrend BIT-FOR-BIT for both the linear (least-squares line) and constant (mean) types; and the linear detrend removes a low-frequency trend that constant (mean) removal leaves in -- so the sub-1-Hz spectral power is markedly lower after linear than after constant detrending.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel Fpz (frontopolar, the largest linear drift), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: detrendSignal equals scipy.signal.detrend to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) for linear and constant, AND linear detrend leaves less sub-1-Hz power than constant detrend
